hypotheses.title: Smoothed Informed Options Flow: Put-Call Volume Ratio Decay
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Refines the 0.78-subuniverse Sharpe put-call volume ratio anomaly by smoothing raw daily volume fluctuations with a 15-day linear decay (ts_decay_linear). Sizing the smoothing window over 15 trading days filters high-frequency noise and suppresses portfolio turnover from 52% to under 20%, elevating Fitness past 1.00 while preserving the strong informed options flow signal.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if 15-day smoothing degrades sub-universe Sharpe below 0.38 or fails to reduce turnover below 25%.

candidates.rationale: 15-day linearly smoothed put/call volume ratio with 5-day smoothed delta reversal
20-day linearly smoothed put/call volume ratio power-scaled with decay=6

hypotheses.title: Structural Options Positioning: Open Interest Put-Call Ratio
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Replaces high-turnover daily trading volume with cumulative Open Interest (pcr_oi_all). Open interest tracks total outstanding institutional contracts across all maturities, providing a low-turnover (<12%) structural indicator of option market positioning and call accumulation.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if open interest adjustments lag directional stock price moves.

candidates.rationale: Open interest put/call ratio with 5-day smoothed delta reversal
